title: MCP Apps and Skills Extensions
summary: The official MCP Apps (iframe UI through ui:// resources and _meta.ui) and Skills (Agent Skills served by skills/list and skills/get) extensions, measured without a host on the C# SDK 2.4.0 and checked against the source. The real state (Apps protocol Stable, its package API [Experimental] MCPEXP003; Skills Beta with MCPEXP005, a single 2.4.0 release), negotiation on the wire and what a client without the extension sees, where the CSP travels and two traps in the typed helpers, the now case-sensitive property names (2.3.0 against 2.4.0), Skills digest verification and tampering, and who implements them today. Host rendering is docs only.
